title: PRDBench 44 Beijing Subway Fare Calculation System

requirements.name: Path modes
requirements.description: Three path query modes: shortest distance, least transfer, comprehensive optimal.

requirements.name: Transfer limit
requirements.description: Maximum transfer limit is configurable and filters out paths exceeding it; complex transfer stations are handled.

requirements.name: Line preference
requirements.description: Line preference is configurable and reroutes the path onto the preferred line when it exists.

requirements.name: Fare calculation
requirements.description: Fare tiers, boundary handling and the extended rule over 32 km.

requirements.name: Travel time
requirements.description: Estimated travel time from distance and transfer count.

requirements.name: Export
requirements.description: Text and JSON export with the agreed layout and fields.

requirements.name: CLI query
requirements.description: Startup, input reception, continuous query, input validation, invalid station detection, data coverage and data management through the CLI.
